title: Spectro-electrochemical, fluorometric and biothermodynamic evaluation of pharmacologically active morpholine scaffold single crystal ligand and its metal(II) complexes: A comparative study on in-vitro and in-silico screening towards DNA/BSA/SARS-CoV-19.
authors: Sakthikumar, Karunganathan; Krause, Rui Werner Macedo; Isamura, Bienfait Kabuyaya; Raja, Jeyaraj Dhaveethu; Athimoolam, Shanmuganarayanan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吗啉席夫碱金属配合物与DNA/BSA的结合及对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: A novel series of metal(II) complexes (1-5) [M(II)(L)(2)]Where M = Cu (1), Co (2), Mn (3), Ni (4) and Zn (5) constructed from 2-(4-morpholinobenzylideneamino)phenol Schiff base ligand (HL) in a 1:2 M ratio and the spectral and analytical results put forward square planar geometry. Spectro-electrochemical, hydrodynamic, gel electrophoresis, and DNA binding/cleavage results for all the compounds demonstrate that complex (1) had excellent DNA binding/cleavage properties compared to other compounds. The observation also suggests that test compounds could intercalate with DNA, and the biothermodynamic property more strongly supports the stabilizing of the double helix DNA with the complexes. BSA binding constant results show that complex (1) exposes the best binding property via a static mode, which is further confirmed by FRET calculations. The DFT calculations and docking results for all compounds towards DNA, BSA and SARS-CoV-19 main protease (3CLPro), reveal the binding energies were in the range of -7.8 to -9.4, -6.6 to -10.2 and - 6.1 - -8.2 kcal/mol for all test compounds respectively. In this case, complexes showed favorable binding energies compared to free ligand, which stimulates further studies aimed at validating the predicted activity as well as contributing to tackling the current and future viral pandemics. The in-vitro antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer results for all compounds revealed that copper complex (1) has better activity compared to others. This might result in an effective anticancer drug for future research, which is especially promising since the observed experimental results for all cases were in close agreement with the theoretical calculations.
abstract_zh: 一系列新型金属(II)配合物（1-5）[M(II)(L)(2)]，其中M = Cu (1), Co (2), Mn (3), Ni (4) 和 Zn (5)，由2-(4-吗啉苄叉氨基)苯酚席夫碱配体（HL）以1:2的金属配体摩尔比构建，光谱及分析结果表明其为平面正方形几何构型。所有化合物的光谱电化学、流体动力学、凝胶电泳及DNA结合/切割结果表明，与其他化合物相比，配合物（1）具有优异的DNA结合/切割性能。观察结果还表明，测试化合物可能嵌入DNA，且生物热力学性质更强烈地支持配合物对双螺旋DNA的稳定作用。BSA结合常数结果显示，配合物（1）通过静态模式展现出最佳结合性能，这进一步由FRET计算所证实。所有化合物对DNA、BSA及SARS-CoV-19主蛋白酶（3CLPro）的DFT计算和对接结果表明，所有测试化合物的结合能范围分别为-7.8至-9.4、-6.6至-10.2和-6.1至-8.2 kcal/mol。在此情况下，配合物相比自由配体显示出更有利的结合能，这促进了旨在验证预测活性以及为应对当前和未来病毒大流行做出贡献的进一步研究。所有化合物的体外抗氧化、抗菌和抗癌结果显示，铜配合物（1）相比其他化合物具有更好的活性。这可能为未来研究提供一种有效的抗癌药物，尤其令人鼓舞的是，所有情况下的实验观察结果与理论计算高度一致。
